title: EVDB - Electric Vehicle Database
description: Comprehensive, open-source database of electric vehicles with technical specifications, market availability, and pricing. Built with YAML, validated with JSON Schema, queryable via SQL.
description_html:
EVDB is a comprehensive, open-source database of electric vehicles with:

  • Battery and charging specifications
  • Real-world range data
  • Market pricing and availability
  • Technical details (motors, dimensions, weight)

Data is stored in human-readable YAML, validated with JSON Schema, and exposed via Datasette API.

columns.name: Model name
columns.segment: Market segment (A, B, C, D, E, F, S, J, M)

vehicle_variants.title: Vehicle Variants
vehicle_variants.description: Specific vehicle variants with detailed specifications (trim levels, battery options)

market_availability.title: Market Availability
market_availability.description: Vehicle pricing, options, and availability by market/country

market_incentives.title: Market Incentives
market_incentives.description: Government incentives and subsidies by market

connectors.title: Charging Connectors
connectors.description: EV charging connector types and specifications

view_vehicles_full.title: Complete Vehicle Data
view_vehicles_full.description: Full vehicle information with manufacturer and model details joined

view_vehicles_latest.title: Latest Model Year Vehicles
view_vehicles_latest.description: Only the most recent model year for each variant

vehicles_by_range.title: Find vehicles by range
vehicles_by_range.description: Search for vehicles with minimum WLTP range
vehicles_by_range.sql: SELECT manufacturer_name, model_name, variant_name, battery_usable_kwh, range_wltp_km, range_real_world_km, price_base_eur FROM view_vehicles_full WHERE range_wltp_km >= :min_range ORDER BY range_wltp_km DESC

vehicles_by_charging_speed.title: Fast charging vehicles
vehicles_by_charging_speed.description: Vehicles with minimum DC fast charging power
vehicles_by_charging_speed.sql: SELECT manufacturer_name, model_name, variant_name, dc_charge_power_kw, dc_charge_time_10_80_min, range_wltp_km FROM view_vehicles_full WHERE dc_charge_power_kw >= :min_power ORDER BY dc_charge_power_kw DESC

vehicles_by_price.title: Find vehicles by base price (EUR)
vehicles_by_price.description: Search vehicles within price range (base EUR price)
vehicles_by_price.sql: SELECT manufacturer_name, model_name, variant_name, price_base_eur, range_wltp_km, battery_usable_kwh FROM view_vehicles_full WHERE price_base_eur IS NOT NULL AND price_base_eur BETWEEN :min_price AND :max_price ORDER BY price_base_eur

vehicles_by_efficiency.title: Most efficient vehicles
vehicles_by_efficiency.description: Vehicles sorted by real-world energy efficiency
vehicles_by_efficiency.sql: SELECT manufacturer_name, model_name, variant_name, consumption_real_world_kwh_100km, range_wltp_km, range_real_world_km FROM view_vehicles_full WHERE consumption_real_world_kwh_100km IS NOT NULL ORDER BY consumption_real_world_kwh_100km ASC

vehicles_comparison.title: Compare specific vehicles
vehicles_comparison.sql: SELECT * FROM view_vehicles_full WHERE variant_id IN (:ids)

market_overview.title: Market overview by country
market_overview.description: All available vehicles from manufacturers based in a specific country
market_overview.sql: SELECT manufacturer_name, manufacturer_country, model_name, variant_name, range_wltp_km, battery_usable_kwh, dc_charge_power_kw FROM view_vehicles_full WHERE manufacturer_country = :country ORDER BY manufacturer_name, model_name

latest_additions.title: Latest model years
latest_additions.sql: SELECT manufacturer_name, model_name, variant_name, model_year, battery_usable_kwh, range_wltp_km FROM view_vehicles_latest ORDER BY model_year DESC LIMIT 20

long_range_evs.title: Long-range EVs (500km+)
long_range_evs.sql: SELECT manufacturer_name, model_name, variant_name, battery_usable_kwh, range_wltp_km, range_real_world_km, price_base_eur FROM view_vehicles_full WHERE range_wltp_km >= 500 ORDER BY range_wltp_km DESC

budget_evs.title: Budget EVs under €40k
budget_evs.description: Affordable electric vehicles with base EUR pricing
budget_evs.sql: SELECT manufacturer_name, model_name, variant_name, price_base_eur, range_wltp_km, battery_usable_kwh FROM view_vehicles_full WHERE price_base_eur IS NOT NULL AND price_base_eur < 40000 ORDER BY price_base_eur

performance_evs.title: Performance EVs
performance_evs.description: Fast-accelerating electric vehicles (0-100 km/h under 5 seconds)
performance_evs.sql: SELECT manufacturer_name, model_name, variant_name, acceleration_0_100_sec, total_power_kw, drive_type, range_wltp_km FROM view_vehicles_full WHERE acceleration_0_100_sec IS NOT NULL AND acceleration_0_100_sec < 5.0 ORDER BY acceleration_0_100_sec

all_vehicles.title: All vehicles overview
all_vehicles.description: Complete list of all vehicles in the database
all_vehicles.sql: SELECT manufacturer_name, model_name, variant_name, model_year, battery_usable_kwh, range_wltp_km, dc_charge_power_kw, total_power_kw FROM view_vehicles_full ORDER BY manufacturer_name, model_name, variant_name
